result:
Comment authors can now edit their own comments. I didn't run tests, lint or the app, so none of this has been checked.

- **API:** `features/comments/api/update-comment.ts` adds `updateComment`, which sends `PATCH /comments/{commentId}` with `{ body }`. It also adds `useUpdateComment`, which refreshes the discussion's comments list after saving.
- **Success message:** `useUpdateComment` shows a "Comment Updated" notification. A lint rule says feature components must not call `useNotifications`, so I put it in the hook instead of the component, unlike `create-comment.tsx` and `delete-comment.tsx`.
- **UI:** `features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx` is an "Edit Comment" button that opens a form drawer with the body pre-filled. `comments-list.tsx` shows it only on the current user's own comments, next to the Delete button.
- **Permission:** I added a `comment:update` policy in `lib/authorization.tsx` that allows only the comment's author. Admins can delete any comment but can't edit other people's.
- **Mock API:** I added a PATCH handler to `testing/mocks/handlers/comments.ts` that only updates a comment if the logged-in user wrote it.

The lint hook's first complaint was about `useNotifications` in the component, and I fixed that. It fired again after my second edit. A search of the component afterwards found no remaining `Notification` references, so I think that second report came from before the import was removed.
